rationale: Both of my round-2 asks are addressed at reviewed commit 8abb8e065ab2eacd505418c7ed0415fd22b73999. The ordinary row fixtures no longer seed their authoritative stored phase from agreementTableRows, and each of the seven affected rows adds a stored-independent DerivePhaseFromChildren assertion over independently fixed children. A joint guide-plus-record mutation in a disposable clone left the structural cross-pin green but made the executable complete-to-review row fail on derivation, state show, tail selection, and the child-only derivation, proving the requested anti-circularity property. Row 1 is no longer represented as a self-authorized carve-out: its canonical committed draft fixture is checked through three distinct paths, with resolve.DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache invoked using a fresh cache independently of the WorktreeSpec tail proxy and required to confirm the draft before the derivation cell is pinned to spec. The guide preserves the proxy disclosure. In my schema/correctness lens, the guide rows match R1.3's canonical modes and carve-outs, ADR-0023's two stale rows are visibly superseded and point unambiguously to the refined some-closed plus some-open plus none-in_progress equals implement rule, and the spec-095 amendment is untouched by the round-3 fix. No concrete change remains. `go build ./...` succeeded and the focused agreement suite passed all 13 rows plus the doc cross-pin. An attempted unshortened `go test ./...` encountered unrelated sandbox/integration timeouts after ten minutes in cmd/mindspec, internal/harness, internal/instruct, and internal/validate; internal/phase passed in that run, and the focused uncached agreement suite passed separately in 3.299s. The reviewed worktree remained clean and byte-identical, and the sole /tmp probe clone was deleted.

findings.title: Canonical fixture inputs and expected table cells are independently derived
findings.detail: Rows 2 through 8 now seed v2Epic with locally hardcoded verb-result Mode literals rather than row.derivation and call assertChildDerivation on independently fixed child sets. The terminal row similarly hardcodes done; writer-driven release and repair rows exercise their production writers. In /tmp, I changed both the complete-to-review guide cells and agreementTableRows record from review to plan while leaving production and fixture inputs untouched. TestAgreementTable_DocRowsCrossPinFixtures passed, but TestAgreementTable_Rows failed with actual review versus expected plan on the status-aware derivation, state-show resolution, tail context/template selection, and DerivePhaseFromChildren. This is the exact round-2 acceptance probe and demonstrates that a coordinated doc-plus-record error is red rather than self-fulfilling.

findings.title: Spec-create has the tally-ruled independent derivation assertion
findings.detail: rowSpecCreate builds the canonical pre-epic draft as a committed spec.md plus spec/<id> branch with a healthy empty tracker. State show uses ResolveModeWithCache; the disclosed tail proxy uses ResolveContextFromDirWithCache's WorktreeSpec branch; and the derivation leg separately calls DiscoverDraftSpecsWithCache with a fresh Cache, requires that enumeration to confirm this spec ID as a draft, then pins the row derivation to state.ModeSpec. No sentinel or row-1 carve-out remains. The row passed in the focused uncached suite.

findings.title: ADR supersession annotations and guide contract remain correct
findings.detail: Both stale ADR edge-case rows are struck. The first points directly to the refined some-lifecycle-closed plus some-open plus none-in_progress equals implement row; the blocked-mix annotation explains that blocked is neither closed nor in_progress and names the same governing refined row. Diffing 6f75235b to 8abb8e06 shows no ADR change, so the bead-3/spec-095 amendment text remains untouched. The guide retains R1.3's complete, release, plan-approve, and terminal shapes and explicitly retains the row-1 WorktreeSpec-proxy scope disclosure.
